cohort: 237 women who delivered between December 2012 and September 2013 at the Instituto Nacional Materno Perinatal or the Hospital Nacional Arzobispo Loayza in Lima, Peru
finding: Maternal and perinatal complications were common (over 37% of women experienced at least one), with hypertension/preeclampsia and macrosomia being the most frequent, and the cesarean section rate was high (50.2%).
